say:2:1421429001:1.text: Hymns praising Helthor, discarded schematics, battle records of Helthor leading his warriors...
say:2:1421429001:1.source_cn: 赞颂赫托的诗歌，作废的早期设计图，记载赫托带领勇敢战士...

say:3:1421429002:1.text: Nothing immediately useful. Did Seralyth actually care about preserving history?
say:3:1421429002:1.source_cn: 都是些派不上用场的记载吗……奈萨雷斯有保存历史的爱好？

say:4:1421429003:1.text: Oh please, My mother didn't preserve history out of sentiment. There was no time for hobbies in her glorious reign.
say:4:1421429003:1.source_cn: 我母亲对保存历史毫无兴趣，她的伟大人生里也没有“爱好”...

say:8:1421429007:1.text: Either way, let's do a quick sort. If nothing jumps out as urgent, we can return these to your dwarven friends. Call it history returning to where it belongs.

say:9:1421429008:1.source_cn: 嗯，祖娅看到这些应该会很高兴。
